_notes._: Reviewed known violations. Each rule says why it is accepted for now and where it is tracked. Counts are violating nodes per rule per component; see specs/axe.spec.ts.
_notes.aria-allowed-attr: #7: aria-expanded on a plain <input> (date-picker, combobox) and on the hover-card trigger wrapper, which have no role that allows it; the role belongs on the focusable element.
_notes.aria-dialog-name: #7: the hover-card body is role=dialog with no name (noted in hover-card.ts).
_notes.aria-input-field-name: #7 duplicate roles: void-input, void-textarea, void-slider, void-number-input and void-tags-input put an unnamed widget role on the host while the inner native control is the real, labelled one.
_notes.aria-required-children: #7: void-menu nests role=listbox between menu and menuitems; void-tags-input is role=listbox around a text input; void-nav-menu (menubar) holds plain links.
_notes.aria-required-parent: #7: void-menu-item sits in the listbox described above; void-tag is role=listitem even outside a list (untracked).
_notes.color-contrast: Light theme: void-stat's success delta on its tint is 4.28:1 (needs 4.5:1); the tint gap is noted in lint:contrast (untracked).
_notes.label: Untracked: the compact void-color-picker's hex input has no label.
_notes.landmark-banner-is-top-level: Untracked: void-banner is role=banner, a page landmark, even when used as an in-page notice inside <main>.
_notes.nested-interactive: #7 duplicate roles: checkbox, radio, slider and color-picker hosts are focusable widgets around native controls; a void-button wrapping an <a> (link button) is a button around a link.
_notes.scrollable-region-focusable: Untracked: void-scroll-area's viewport cannot be scrolled by keyboard unless its content is focusable.
_notes.target-size: Untracked: sidebar and breadcrumb links, carousel indicators and the compact colour input are under 24x24 px; the link button's anchor is partly covered by its host's padding.
